test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
There are six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F. A, B, C and F are male and other two are female. The height of A is 5.2 feet, B is 5.7 feet, C is 5.9 feet, D is 5.4 feet, E is 6.0 feet and F is 6.1 feet. Out of these all, A, B, C and E like sugar, and D and F like salt. Persons who have a height of more than 5.5 feet wear black, and others wear white.

Who among these is the sugar-loving male who does NOT wear black?
solution:

Out of these all, A, B, C and E like sugar, and D and F like salt.
